stories.headline: Saudi Arabia threatens military action against Iran as foreign minister declares trust 'completely shattered'
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan warned Iran that Saudi Arabia reserves the right to take military action after repeated attacks, declaring that trust between the countries has been 'completely shattered.' The warnings came after a meeting of Arab and Islamic foreign ministers in Riyadh.

stories.headline: Iranian forces attack multiple Saudi Aramco oil facilities amid regional escalation
stories.summary: Iran targeted several Saudi Aramco facilities including the Ras Tanura refinery and SAMREF facility in Yanbu. The Ras Tanura refinery was temporarily shut down before restarting operations on March 13. The attacks are part of Iran's retaliation against US-Israeli strikes.

stories.headline: Saudi air defenses intercept hundreds of Iranian drones and missiles in sustained attacks
stories.summary: Saudi Ministry of Defense announced intercepting at least 438 drones and 36 ballistic missiles since Iran began retaliatory strikes. The attacks targeted multiple regions including Riyadh, Eastern Province, and Al-Jawf, with debris from intercepted missiles causing limited damage and minor injuries.

stories.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has been privately encouraging President Trump to maintain military pressure on Iran, echoing advice once given by the late King Abdullah to 'cut off the head of the snake.' The conversations highlight growing Saudi support for US-Israeli operations against Iran.

stories.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi in Jeddah to discuss the dangerous escalation in the region. Both leaders condemned Iranian attacks on Gulf states and emphasized the threat to regional security and stability.

He also delivered an Eid Al-Fitr message emphasizing Saudi Arabia's role in supporting global peace and commending the armed forces' heroic role in defending the Kingdom.

stories.summary: NEOM officially cancelled contracts for The Line's $1 billion tunnel infrastructure, with Hyundai E&C confirming termination of the 12.5-kilometer underground project. The cancellations signal broader restructuring of the flagship Vision 2030 megaproject amid economic pressures.

stories.summary: Saudi Arabia declared the Iranian military attache and four embassy staff members persona non grata, ordering them to leave the country. The expulsion followed Iranian attacks on Saudi oil facilities and represents a significant diplomatic escalation.
